title: V3 Burn grace state is keyed by pool, not by position: with two positions on one pool the second Burn handling cancels the first position grace watcher, so on a Burn without a Collect only one position is evaluated

evidence.note: a prior pending entry for the pool has its watcher removed
the entry stores a single position
dispatchEvent calls the evaluator once per position on the pool, so the second position call replaces the first entry for the same Burn
on the grace timeout only the stored (last) position is evaluated
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): V3 pending Burns collide across trades and chains

sibling_sites_checked: The Collect path (detector.ts:2174-2204) evaluates every position because each call runs evaluateV3MultiSignal whether or not a pending entry exists; only the Burn-without-Collect path is affected. Two positions on one pool arise from the double-buy race AUD-BUY-004.
severity_rationale: S3: needs two positions on one V3 pool (the AUD-BUY-004 double buy) and a rug whose Collect comes more than 5 blocks after the Burn, or never; the first position then gets no anti-rug evaluation for that Burn. The routine exit monitor still runs.
recommendation: Key pending Burns by pool and position (or keep a list per pool) and cancel them on unregister. Phase 29.
